Since \(f\) is linear in \(t_2\), its endpoints are
\[
f(t_2=0)=(1-t_3)(1-t_1)\ge 0,
\]
\[
f(t_2=1)=t_1+t_3-1+(1-t_3)(1-t_1)=t_1t_3\ge 0.
\]
Thus \(f\ge 0\) on the whole cube, so
\[
E[|f|]=E[f].
\]
Recomputing:
\[
E[f]=1-\frac12+\frac14+\frac14+\frac14-\frac12-\frac12=\frac14.
\]
Therefore the expected area is
\[
60\cdot \frac14=15.
\]
\[
\boxed{15}
\]
